findings.summary: The masking and fencing exemption trusts the KERNEL- prefix; a plugin's extra_findings with a KERNEL- id reach a hosted route unmasked and unfenced.
A removed secret logs a class_route drop but the observation is not marked masked or partial (PR-21).
Undeclared key names at the root and inside declared containers reach an undeclared hosted route verbatim.
Strings starting with [masked: are exempt from bounding, so a provider value can pose as a kernel mask marker.
KERNEL-PLAN-STRUCTURE embeds pydantic input values, against ADR 0032 §5's kernel-text assumption.
Assembly also fails when referenced evidence does not fit, a condition the ADR does not state; record as a plan ruling.
Concerns 3, 4, 6, 7 acceptable or deferred; 3d.3/3d.4 must pass referenced_evidence, deferred_pending and observation_turns.
Confirmed sound: ClassIndex rules, number rendering, fence, purity, the registry_records move, principles edits, tests.
